name: Applicant tracking
summary: A hiring tracker for a small business: jobs, applicants, one application per job through nine stages, a scorecard per interviewer and a date to delete rejected applications.
description: Run hiring from one place: each job has a status, a hiring manager and a pay range; each application moves from new to hired or rejected with its interview time, offer deadline and rejection reason; every interviewer files a scorecard. Rejected applications get a retention date so you remember to delete them or ask for consent. It is not a job board, a CV parser, an assessment platform, an offer-letter or e-signature tool, or a legal authority on retention periods.

prompt.intro: Set up applicant tracking in my Customermates workspace: jobs with a hiring manager and pay range, applicants, applications through nine stages, interview scorecards, a retention date for rejected applications and dated follow-ups.
questions: How many jobs are open at a time, and who hires for each?
Where do applicants come from, and do you use an application form?
How long do you keep rejected applications, and do you keep a talent pool with consent?
Which interview rounds do you run, and who files a scorecard?
